x: In the girls' under 15 event Laura Fryer continued her competition against fellow Kent athlete Nichola Phillips from Dartford - a challenge that was to last throughout the season.

In the under 15 girls' event she chased the National Champion, Nicola Phillips of Dartford, all the way to the line. Laura had actually beaten her rival and friend the previous week in the Kent Schools Championships but here just lost out by 10 metres in spite of reducing her best ever time by another 18 seconds.

Laura Fryer fought for the whole of her 3,000m race with Dartford's Nichola Phillips and Solihull's Kelly Mann. Unfortunately her early race tussles with the Dartford girl used up her reserves and her rival from Solihull caught and passed her on the last lap.
